name: UNIT ZERO Operation Black Veil
detailed_description:
UNIT ZERO is a hyper-realistic first-person shooter blending tactical action, horror, and science fiction. Dive into intense multiplayer matches or fight off relentless waves in Zombies mode — all within an immersive, tension-filled atmosphere.

A breach that should never have been opened...

In a desperate attempt to solve global overpopulation, a secret group of scientists launched a forbidden experiment: opening a dimensional rift to a parallel Earth.
A planet identical to ours. No humans. Untouched resources... or so they thought.
What awaited on the other side changed the fate of humanity forever.

Key Features:

  • Photorealistic bodycam-style graphics that draw you deep into every encounter.

  • Competitive multiplayer mode, built for tactical squads and fast-paced action.

  • Cooperative Zombies mode, where survival depends on teamwork and coordination.

  • A dark, disturbing story told through environmental details, hidden recordings, and classified documents.

  • Immersive sound design that heightens the tension and amplifies the horror at every turn.

Prepare to cross the breach...
But remember: not everything that seems uninhabited is truly empty.

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains intense violence, blood, strong language, and elements of psychological horror.
Some scenes may be unsettling due to dark environments, paranoia effects, and disturbing content.
There is no explicit sexual content, but the game does explore sensitive themes such as failed human experiments, mutations, and extreme psychological consequences.
Discretion is advised, especially for players sensitive to horror or prolonged emotional stress.
